name: Soshage no Gacha o Saseru Kawari ni ****gakusei no Karada o Suki Houdai ni Shita Hanashi
original_name: ソシャゲのガチャをさせる代わりに○学生の体を好き放題にした話
source:
A young girl is addicted to a crane game on her cell phone.
Oh, if only she could get that special character!
The nice man uses her own obsession to lure her into bed.
She'll do anything for a few more tokens and a flimsy shot at winning!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE168519.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻女孩沉迷于手机上的夹娃娃游戏。
哦，如果她能得到那个特殊的角色就好了！
好男人用自己的痴迷引诱她上床。
为了更多的代币和微弱的获胜机会，她愿意做任何事！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE168519.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
